summary: Trident Digital Tech Holdings, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a completed registered direct offering of 30,000,000 Class B ordinary shares at US$0.50 per share for US$15.0 million gross proceeds. The Securities Purchase Agreement was signed September 27, 2026 and closed September 29, 2026 under an effective Form F-3 shelf. Investors paid in USDC or USDT, which the company may convert to fiat for digital asset reserves and general corporate purposes. No underwriter or placement agent participated. Post-closing capitalization was 58,854,494 Class B and 208,333 Class A shares. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution, crypto-denominated settlement and Class B voting overhang.
